text.zh-CN: 超声胆囊壁1.1 cm、双层增厚；CT一致，增强见环形强化，无腹水。
text.en: Ultrasound showed a1.1 cm thick double-layer gallbladder wall; CT agreed with ring enhancement, without ascites.

text.zh-CN: 抗菌治疗10天无明显改善后胆囊切除；水肿、充血、壁脆，无结石。病理报告胆囊结核，抗酸染色阳性。
text.en: After ten days without clear antibiotic benefit, cholecystectomy showed oedema, congestion and friability without stones. Histology was reported as gallbladder tuberculosis with positive acid-fast staining.

text.zh-CN: 胆囊组织病理与抗酸阳性支持分枝杆菌感染，原报告诊断胆囊结核
text.en: Gallbladder histology and acid-fast positivity support mycobacterial infection, reported as gallbladder tuberculosis

feedback.zh-CN: 病灶组织证据比阴性肺部筛查更直接，菌种确证仍缺资料。
feedback.en: Lesion tissue is more direct than negative pulmonary screening, while species confirmation is incomplete.

text.zh-CN: PPD阴性已完全排除任何结核
text.en: NegativePPD completely excludes tuberculosis

feedback.zh-CN: 皮试阴性不能排除活动性病，尤其免疫抑制背景。
feedback.en: A negative skin test does not exclude active disease, particularly with immunosuppression.

text.zh-CN: 胆囊没结石就不可能发炎
text.en: No stones means gallbladder inflammation is impossible

feedback.zh-CN: 影像和组织已经记录明显病变。
feedback.en: Imaging and tissue document substantial disease.

prompt.zh-CN: 今天如何继续评估治疗？

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。
need.en: First review the relevant history and source records available in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 感染与风湿团队核对病理、培养/核酸及药敏可能性，评估抗结核方案和免疫抑制用药
text.en: Infection/rheumatology teams review pathology, feasible culture/molecular susceptibility work and tuberculosis therapy alongside immunosuppression

feedback.zh-CN: 需确认病原和药物风险，不能照搬未记载的剂量。
feedback.en: Pathogen and medication risks require review; undocumented doses cannot be copied.

text.zh-CN: 病理提示结核后继续原抗菌药无限等待
text.en: Continue the same routine antibiotics indefinitely after suggestive histology

feedback.zh-CN: 需要重新选择针对性评估与治疗路径。
feedback.en: The evidence requires a revised targeted pathway.

text.zh-CN: 无需会诊自行加大泼尼松控制发热
text.en: Increase prednisone independently to suppress fever

feedback.zh-CN: 可能加重感染，应整体评估。
feedback.en: This may aggravate infection and requires integrated review.

prompt.zh-CN: 退热后可以确定哪些结论？
prompt.en: What can be concluded after defervescence?

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。

text.en: Improvement followed tuberculosis therapy, but reactivation mechanism, species confirmation and completed course are not established

feedback.zh-CN: 原文提出免疫抑制致再激活的可能，非直接证明。

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 以通俗语言说明主要判断、下一步及至少一项具体未知，询问理解和顾虑；不得声称未载明的疗效或预后。
judgeGuidance.en: Use plain language for the interpretation, next step and at least one case-specific uncertainty; check understanding and concerns, without asserting undocumented benefit or prognosis.

knowledge.zh-CN: 先区分病史、检查和推论；指出不确定性。后续经过须在完成当前决策后查阅。
knowledge.en: Distinguish history, findings and inference, and state uncertainty. The subsequent course is reviewed after completing the current decisions.

conclusion.zh-CN: 类风湿用药背景下胆囊病理及抗酸阳性支持原报告胆囊结核诊断，阴性肺部/皮试不能排除肺外病，菌种与疗程信息仍缺失。
conclusion.en: In a patient receiving rheumatoid medications, gallbladder histology/AFB supported the reported tuberculosis diagnosis; negative pulmonary/skin tests do not exclude extrapulmonary disease, while species and treatment-course details are missing.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 阴性皮试不能用于排除活动性结核。
keyReasoning.en: A negative skin test cannot rule out active tuberculosis.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 病灶组织证据与菌种确证不是同一层级。
keyReasoning.en: Lesion evidence and species confirmation are different levels.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 治疗反应不能确定感染来源与再激活机制。
keyReasoning.en: Treatment response does not establish infection source or reactivation.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例回顾不能证明因果或比较疗效。数字仅为原报告时点记录，不是实时监测；没有参考区间的数据不自行补区间。
boundaries.en: A single retrospective report cannot establish causality or comparative efficacy. Numbers are source time-point records, not live monitoring; missing reference intervals are not invented.
